name: 大袋结团粘土猫砂多猫家庭款

styleLock.direction: clean clinical pet-care commerce, lake-blue and paper-white retail packshot system with light infographic scaffolding
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for the packshot and the macro and spec screens, warm light-grey field #F1EFEA for the info and how-to screens, deep lake-blue panel #1F7BC0 for the pain and trust screens; one flat panel per frame, no scenery drift
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool-neutral high-key studio light, broad front-left key plus white fill card, soft contact shadows that always ground the bag, no hard speculars; lifestyle scenes switch to 5500K window light from the left while keeping the same shadow direction
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte pale oak floor #D9B183 in lifestyle scenes only; seamless paper-white and warm light-grey boards #F1EFEA on every packshot, macro, comparison and spec screen; shallow white tray rims as the recurring stage prop
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif hierarchy reserved as blank caption bars and empty plate layouts; in this detached set every letter slot stays empty so any seller copy can be dropped in later
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icon plates in deep lake-blue #1F7BC0 on white circles, kept deliberately glyph-free, one sunny yellow accent #F2C230 for markers only
styleLock.presentationRules: the tall sealed bag keeps one stable slight 3/4 or straight-on hero angle, constant scale and constant edge clearance across the set; animals appear only as generic pets whose identity is irrelevant; every proof element stays an empty plate rather than a claim
noDrift: no inconsistent lighting or shadow direction
no rendered words, numerals, percentages or units anywhere
no platform badges, star strips or social-proof ribbons
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium pet-care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, warm light-grey field #F1EFEA, deep lake-blue panel #1F7BC0 and one sunny yellow accent #F2C230; cool neutral high-key studio lighting with a broad front-left key, white fill card and soft grounding contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif kept as blank caption bars in this detached set; consistent thin single-weight line icon plates left glyph-free; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic scaffolding; stable slight 3/4 packshot angle and fixed product scale; matte pale oak floor #D9B183 only in lifestyle scenes; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no rendered words or numerals, no badges or star strips.

shots.promptTemplate: Product packshot photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A tall upright sealed bag standing square to the camera, photographed straight-on at eye level with the full silhouette contained inside the frame. Bright even high-key studio light from a broad front-left source with a white fill card on the shadow side, one soft contact shadow grounding the base. Negative: no props, no animals, no hands, no watermark, no corner badges, no star ratings, no price or platform stickers, no overlaid copy blocks, no gradient background, no cropped edges, no floating bag without a contact shadow.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 为纯白底直立大袋装结团粘土猫砂，袋身有卧猫照片、英文字标与四行卖点条、右下角爪印颗粒图形；002 为蓝顶白底三步用法图（倒砂/铲砂/补砂三格小插画＋蓝色砂铲道具＋数字圆标＋护理提示文字块）；003 为品牌故事双栏（左侧标题加正文段落，右侧倾斜袋身，上下蓝色色带，配卡通猫头猫爪）；004 为左图标双条＋右猫实拍照片＋蓝色斜角块的混排卖点页；005 为真实家景：猫站在浅砂盆中，袋身在后方虚化，木地板；006 为双栏信息页（左侧两培养皿落尘对照与百分比主张，右侧开口袋身）；007 为蓝白分栏（左侧手写字与一堆颗粒俯视，右侧两组圆形图标加文字条）；008 为浅灰底俯视：猫居左上、白砂盆满砂居中偏左，右侧大字标题，右下蓝色三角条；009 为纯图标四宫格（两行两列圆形细线图标加英文标签）。品类判定依据：提示品类为大袋宠物用品，但图中产品是倒入砂盆、结团铲走的清洁耗材，既非主粮也非零食，按 taxonomy 全表就近取 L1 宠物用品、L2 清洁，leaf 自定为结团型粘土猫砂；productFamily 取最接近的 home。已剥离内容：源包装上的英文字标、系列名、口号、医生形象徽记与右下角爪印颗粒专属图形；袋身与各色版上的全部英文字句（含低尘百分比、第一销路类社会证明、成分配比、净重与铺设厚度数字、护理提示整段文案）；平台角标与星级样式一律未采用；源图中的实拍猫与卡通猫形象仅作通用宠物角色描述，不保留可辨识个体特征。所有参数位改写为空参数条、空白图标盘、空印章框、留空数字圆标与无读数对照盘；产品在任何字段中一律以 {product} 占位。
